industries.name: Manufacturing
industries.headline: Protect Production Before Cyber Risk Becomes Downtime.

One compromised device can become a stopped line. One overlooked dependency can become hours — or days — of lost production.
Security Dawgs helps manufacturers uncover the assets they did not know existed, understand how critical systems connect and identify the exposures that could disrupt operations.
industries.promise: See every connected asset. Understand every dependency. Protect every hour of production.
benefits: Discover IT, OT, IoT and connected production assets
Identify unmanaged or unknown devices
Understand dependencies between systems and production
Prioritize vulnerabilities based on actual operational impact
Reduce the risk of ransomware-driven downtime
Accelerate incident investigation and root-cause analysis
Protect multi-site manufacturing environments
industries.closing: Because when production stops, cybersecurity becomes a revenue problem.

Banks, credit unions, financial services companies and fintech organizations must protect increasingly complex infrastructure while maintaining continuous availability.

industries.name: Telecommunications
industries.headline: Protect the Infrastructure Everyone Else Depends On.

Networks, towers, data centers, cloud infrastructure, circuits, devices and customer systems all depend on one another.
When a critical component fails or is compromised, the impact can spread quickly.
Security Dawgs helps telecommunications organizations understand the relationships across their environment so teams can identify the source of a problem and the services that may be affected.

Security Dawgs helps critical infrastructure organizations identify the systems that matter most, understand how they connect and expose potential risks before those risks become disruptions.

hero.title: KNOW YOUR BLAST RADIUS BEFORE SOMETHING BLOWS UP.
body: You probably know about most of the technology in your environment.

Every unmanaged device. Every forgotten cloud instance. Every undocumented connection. Every unknown dependency creates another place for an outage, configuration error or cyberattack to become something much bigger.

Security Dawgs Asset Intelligence gives you a continuously updated view of your connected environment — showing you what you have, how it connects, what depends on it, what could be affected, and where the greatest risk exists.

visibility.title: YOU CAN'T PROTECT WHAT YOU CAN'T SEE.
body: Traditional asset inventories tell you what should be there.
Security Dawgs helps uncover what is actually there.
Across complex environments, assets constantly appear, disappear, move, change ownership and connect to new systems.
Your inventory needs to keep up.
Asset Intelligence continuously discovers and connects technology across:
Servers, endpoints, switches, routers, firewalls and infrastructure.
Operational technology, production systems and industrial environments.
Connected devices that may never appear in a traditional IT inventory.
Infrastructure, services, workloads and rapidly changing cloud resources.
The systems your employees, customers and business processes depend on.
The business services supported by multiple technologies and dependencies.

dependencies.title: A LIST OF ASSETS ISN'T INTELLIGENCE.
body: Knowing a server exists is useful.
Knowing what happens if that server fails is intelligence.
Security Dawgs goes beyond traditional inventory by understanding the relationships between the assets in your environment.
“What does the business lose if it isn't?”

blast.title: KNOW THE BLAST RADIUS.
body: Which business functions depend on it?
Do you know the answers right now?
Security Dawgs maps upstream and downstream relationships so your team can understand the potential impact of an asset before an incident forces you to figure it out under pressure.

questions.title: THE FIVE QUESTIONS EVERY TECHNOLOGY LEADER SHOULD BE ABLE TO ANSWER.
body: Not what someone documented six months ago.
Not what the CMDB thinks you have.
What is actually connected to your environment today?
Customers depend on all of it working together.
Security Dawgs helps expose those relationships.
3. IF THIS FAILS, WHAT ELSE FAILS?
This is where asset visibility becomes business intelligence.
Understand the downstream impact of a failure before making a change, responding to an incident or deciding which risk deserves immediate attention.
4. WHERE DID THE PROBLEM REALLY START?
The loudest alert isn't always the cause.
One underlying problem can trigger dozens — or hundreds — of symptoms across different systems.
Asset Intelligence gives your team the dependency context needed to work backward toward the initiating problem instead of chasing every downstream alarm independently.
Not every vulnerability represents the same business risk.
A severe vulnerability on an isolated device may represent less operational danger than a moderate vulnerability sitting in the middle of a critical dependency chain.
Security Dawgs helps your team understand:
What the business consequence could be.
Now your team can prioritize based on impact, not just severity.

signals.title: FROM 1,000 ALERTS TO ONE STORY.
body: Traditional security and monitoring tools are very good at telling you that something happened.
Different teams begin investigating different symptoms.
But what if they're all part of the same event?
Security Dawgs adds the relationship context needed to connect those signals and understand the bigger picture.

changes.title: YOUR ENVIRONMENT CHANGES EVERY DAY.
body: Traditional asset inventories can become inaccurate almost as soon as they're updated.
Security Dawgs Asset Intelligence is designed around the idea that your technology environment is alive.
As the environment changes, your understanding of it needs to change with it.
No more relying entirely on yesterday's map to protect today's business.

agentless.title: AGENTLESS BY DESIGN.
body: VISIBILITY SHOULDN'T CREATE ANOTHER MANAGEMENT PROBLEM.
Adding another agent to thousands of devices can create deployment headaches, maintenance requirements and yet another technology footprint your team must manage.
Asset Intelligence is designed to discover and understand your environment using the systems and data sources already available.
That means you can gain deeper visibility without turning asset discovery into another massive deployment project.

tools.title: NO RIP AND REPLACE.
body: MAKE THE TOOLS YOU ALREADY OWN SMARTER.
Security Dawgs Asset Intelligence does not need to make those investments irrelevant.
Think of your existing technology as thousands of individual pieces of information.
Asset Intelligence connects those pieces into a bigger picture.
Add the intelligence that connects them.

planning.title: SEE A CHANGE BEFORE YOU MAKE A CHANGE.
body: A routine update shouldn't become an outage.
Before touching a critical system, wouldn't you want to know exactly what depends on it?
Asset Intelligence can help teams understand potential downstream dependencies before:
Know the potential impact before you hit ENTER.

business.title: TURN CYBERSECURITY INTO BUSINESS CONTEXT.
body: Executives don't care that Router 0043 generated an alert.
Three distribution centers may lose connectivity.
They don't care that DB-PROD-07 has a latency issue.
Customers may not be able to place orders.
They don't care that an OT endpoint disappeared.
Security Dawgs helps connect technical conditions to the systems, locations and operations they support.
That means the conversation moves from:
“Here is the business impact, here is what caused it, and here is what we need to protect first.”

teams.title: DIFFERENT TEAMS. ONE VERSION OF THE TRUTH.
body: See exposures, unexpected relationships, potential attack paths and assets that may have been overlooked.
Understand dependencies, investigate incidents faster and reduce time spent chasing symptoms.
See how infrastructure, circuits, locations and applications connect.
Gain greater visibility into operational technology without treating the production environment like traditional IT.
Understand which technology risks could become operational, financial or reputational risks.
Build greater confidence that the organization's technology inventory reflects the environment that actually exists.

reveals.title: WHAT COULD ASSET INTELLIGENCE REVEAL IN YOUR ENVIRONMENT?
body: Devices operating in your environment that aren't represented in traditional inventory.
Critical relationships known by one engineer — but documented nowhere.
Assets and services with external exposure that deserve closer attention.
The technology chains supporting revenue, production, patient care, transactions or customer service.
Assets where one failure could create disproportionate downstream impact.
Relationships that may create security, operational or compliance concerns.
Assets that exist in documentation but no longer accurately represent the live environment.
Critical technology without clearly identified responsibility.

incident.title: WHEN SOMETHING GOES WRONG, EVERY MINUTE COUNTS.
body: Someone finally finds the engineer who “knows how everything connects.”
Meanwhile, the business is still down.

response.title: THE SECURITY DAWGS APPROACH
body: Understand the affected assets and services.
Less time figuring out what happened.

assessment.title: THE CONNECTED ASSET ASSESSMENT
body: FIND OUT WHAT YOU DON'T KNOW.
You don't need to transform your entire technology environment to discover whether you have a visibility problem.
Start with one defined part of the environment.
Where critical business services may be vulnerable
What the blast radius could look like
Then compare what we discover against what you thought you knew.
You may be surprised by the difference.

closing.title: YOUR CMDB TELLS YOU WHAT SHOULD BE THERE.
body: ASSET INTELLIGENCE SHOWS YOU WHAT'S REALLY THERE.
WHAT THE BUSINESS IMPACT COULD BE.
Because cybersecurity isn't just about finding threats.
It's about understanding what you're protecting.
Before someone else discovers it for you.
